sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球知名的顶尖大学，致力于解决当今世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境领域最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州乃至全球范围内通力合作、锐意创新，寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是该大学宗旨的一部分，旨在提升所有生命形式的生活质量。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 21stCentury.UCDavis.edu。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%无形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: If I was a flower growing wild and free, all I'd want is you to be my sweet honeybee.
sentences.zh: 如果我是一朵野蛮生长、自由盛开的花，我唯一的愿望就是让你做我甜美的采蜜蜂。

sentences.en: And if I was a tree growing tall and green, all I'd want is you to shade me and be my leaves.
sentences.zh: 如果我是一棵高大翠绿的树，我唯一的愿望就是让你为我遮阴，做我的树叶。

sentences.en: So the teenage girl named Juno is walking down the street with a half-empty one-gallon jug of Sunny D citrus beverage in one hand.
sentences.zh: 于是，这个名叫朱诺的青春期女孩手里拿着半壶一加仑的新奇士柑橘饮料，走在街上。

sentences.en: She passes a tree and everything becomes animated.
sentences.zh: 她走过一棵树，周围的一切都变成动画。

sentences.en: It's kind of a lo-fi, unpolished Xerox copy animation inspired by punk rock music flyers.
sentences.zh: 这是一种低保真、未经打磨的施乐复印风格动画，灵感来源于朋克摇滚海报。

sentences.en: So how long did you have that main title music from Juno stuck in your head?
sentences.zh: 话说回来，电影《朱诺》的主题音乐在你脑子里盘旋了多久？

sentences.en: It's still there, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 现在还在脑子里挥之不去吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think so.
sentences.zh: 对，我想是的。

sentences.en: You know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: They're using it on some commercial these days, and when I heard it, I just got flashbacks.
sentences.zh: 现在有些广告也在用这首歌，当我听到它的时候，记忆一下子就涌上心头了。

sentences.en: It was crazy.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: If I was a flower growing wild and free, all I'd want is you to be my sweet honeybee.
sentences.zh: 如果我是一朵野蛮生长、自由盛开的花，我唯一的愿望就是让你做我甜美的采蜜蜂。

sentences.en: And if I was a tree growing tall and green, all I'd want is you to shade me and be my leaves.
sentences.zh: 如果我是一棵高大翠绿的树，我唯一的愿望就是让你为我遮阴，做我的树叶。

sentences.en: The title sequence immediately establishes Juno's quirky worldview.
sentences.zh: 片名字幕一上来就奠定了朱诺古灵精怪的世界观。

sentences.en: You cut your title sequences to music, so you must live with these songs for months at a time, right?
sentences.zh: 你们的片名字幕是配合音乐剪辑的，所以你们一定得和这些歌曲朝夕相处好几个月，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: As a title designer, it's very important that the music that you use in a sequence is something that you love,
sentences.zh: 作为一名片名字幕设计师，字幕中使用的音乐必须是你自己深爱的东西，这一点非常重要。

sentences.en: that you really enjoy working with, because it can be rough otherwise.
sentences.zh: 是你真心喜欢与之合作的东西，因为否则过程会非常艰难。

sentences.en: My name is Gareth Smith, and I am a film title designer.
sentences.zh: 我叫加雷思·史密斯，是一名电影片名字幕设计师。

sentences.en: Gareth and his partner Jenny Lee did the titles for Juno and Up in the Air, among others.
sentences.zh: 加雷思和他的搭档珍妮·李曾为《朱诺》和《在云端》等影片制作片名字幕。

sentences.en: My name is Ian Albinson, and I am the founder and editor-in-chief of Art of the Title, a website that curates title design.
sentences.zh: 我叫伊恩·阿尔宾森，是专门收集和策展片名字幕的网站“片名字幕艺术”的创始人兼总编辑。

sentences.en: Ian's site is awesome.
sentences.zh: 伊恩的网站太棒了。

sentences.en: It's a completely different set of people that do the work.
sentences.zh: 做这项工作的是一群完全不同的人。

sentences.en: That do title sequences.
sentences.zh: 也就是制作片名字幕的人。

sentences.en: People don't always realize that, and I always seem to be always surprised that, oh, someone actually thought about this,
sentences.zh: 人们并不总是意识到这一点，而我总是感到惊讶，哦，原来真的有人去思考这些，

sentences.en: and someone actually gets paid to design and to work on something so separate from the film, yet so connected to the film.
sentences.zh: 而且真的有人拿薪水去设计和创作如此独立于电影、却又与电影紧密相连的东西。

sentences.en: So, fundamentally, a title sequence is a presentation of a legal document to the audience.
sentences.zh: 所以，从根本上讲，片名字幕就是向观众展示一份法律文件。

sentences.en: It's a list of names of the crew and actors and everything who are associated with a film.
sentences.zh: 它是一份与电影相关的工作人员、演员以及所有相关人员的名单。

sentences.en: And then there's the more interesting and artistic reason for the title sequence.
sentences.zh: 然后，片名字幕还有更深层、更具艺术性的原因。

sentences.en: Which is establishing tone and perhaps a storyline.
sentences.zh: 那就是定调，或许还有展现故事情节。

sentences.en: But there are rules.
sentences.zh: 但这也是有规矩的。

sentences.en: When you're doing a studio film, the designer or the company will get a document that's, you know, maybe 10 to 15 pages long.
sentences.zh: 当你制作一部好莱坞大片时，设计师或公司会拿到一份文件，你知道的，可能有 10 到 15 页长。

sentences.en: If you just wrote out the text for the title sequence, it could fit easily on a single page.
sentences.zh: 如果你把片名字幕的文字直接写出来，一页纸就能轻松容纳。

sentences.en: Of course, it's this 15-page document.
sentences.zh: 当然，实际是一份 15 页的文件。

sentences.en: And beside each title, there's several paragraphs of text about how each title needs to be treated.
sentences.zh: 在每个职衔旁边，都有好几段文字，说明每个职衔应该如何处理。

sentences.en: Like maybe in some sequences, the lead two actors require their names to be bigger than the other titles.
sentences.zh: 比如在某些字幕中，男女主角的名字需要比其他职衔更大。

sentences.en: And they'll actually list in the document the exact percentage size that it needs to be bigger than the other titles in the sequence.
sentences.zh: 文件里甚至会列出具体需要比序列中其他名字大百分之多少的精确比例。

sentences.en: So, it's very specific and as a designer, it gets very frustrating and challenging to deal with this.
sentences.zh: 所以它是非常具体的，作为一名设计师，处理这些会让人感到非常沮丧和具有挑战性。

sentences.en: Because it feels very limiting to need to have every single title in the sequence be exactly the same size.
sentences.zh: 因为如果要求序列中的每个职衔都必须完全一样大，会让人感觉非常受限制。

sentences.en: When it comes to innovation and influence in title design, there are two words you need to know.
sentences.zh: 说到片名字幕设计的创新与影响，有两个名字你不得不提。

sentences.en: Saul Bass.
sentences.zh: 索尔·巴斯。

sentences.en: He was a major benchmark in terms of realizing that you could have good design in a title sequence.
sentences.zh: 他在意识到片名字幕也可以有优秀设计方面，树立了一个重大标杆。

sentences.en: When Saul Bass came along, he was a designer that started to work on more promotion for films
sentences.zh: 索尔·巴斯出现时，他是一位先开始从事电影宣传工作的设计师，

sentences.en: and then started to bring his illustration and design style to filMs.
sentences.zh: 然后开始将他的插画和设计风格带入电影中。

sentences.en: He worked with Hitchcock on a number of pieces.
sentences.zh: 他曾与希区柯克合作过多个项目。

sentences.en: If the title sequences of Saul Bass don't immediately spring to mind, do yourself a favor and Google
sentences.zh: 如果索尔·巴斯的片名字幕没有立刻浮现在你的脑海中，答应我，去谷歌搜索一下

sentences.en: Anatomy of Murder, or Man with a Golden Arm, or Psycho, or Vertigo.
sentences.zh: 《桃色案件》、《金臂人》、《惊魂记》或《眩晕》。

sentences.en: So good.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: What I love about some of his earlier title sequences is if you look at them, they're basically animated film posters.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢他早期的一些片名字幕的原因是，如果你仔细看，它们基本上就是动画电影海报。

sentences.en: But a lot of that Saul Bass style faded away in the 80s.
sentences.zh: 但在 80 年代，索尔·巴斯的许多风格逐渐消退了。

sentences.en: You know, the 80s and the 90s, you started to get the branding idea with filMs.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，在 80 年代和 90 年代，电影开始引入品牌化的概念。

sentences.en: And so a lot of title sequences weren't so much title sequences, but were just sort of the logo of the film.
sentences.zh: 因此，许多片名字幕与其说是片名字幕，不如说是电影的某种标志。

sentences.en: And so you're creating the brand for the films, or you have Back to the Future, where it's a very iconic logo design.
sentences.zh: 所以你是在为电影打造品牌，或者就像《回到未来》那样，拥有一个极具标志性的 Logo 设计。

sentences.en: And you have a lot of that in late 80s and early 90s.
sentences.zh: 80 年代末和 90 年代初有很多这种风格。

sentences.en: You didn't see as many complete opening sequences or title sequences, be them standalone or sort of integrated with the film.
sentences.zh: 你很少看到完整的开场序列或片名字幕，无论是独立的还是与电影融为一体的。

sentences.en: Which is not done very much these days.
sentences.zh: 如今这种做法已经不多见了。

sentences.en: I don't know if you've noticed that, but there's not a lot of films where there's just a big logo that you see on the poster, you know?
sentences.zh: 我不知道你有没有注意到，现在很少有电影一上来就是你在海报上看到的那种巨大 Logo，你知道吧？

sentences.en: But then we hit the second major benchmark, the movie Seven.
sentences.zh: 但随后我们迎来了第二个重大标杆，电影《七宗罪》。

sentences.en: Seven.
sentences.zh: 《七宗罪》。

sentences.en: Its titles were created by Kyle Cooper.
sentences.zh: 它的片名字幕由凯尔·库珀创作。

sentences.en: He sort of reintroduced the idea that the title sequence could be its own thing, which is what Bass did, you know, decades earlier.
sentences.zh: 他某种程度上重新引入了“片名字幕可以成为独立艺术品”的概念，正如巴斯在几十年前所做的那样。

sentences.en: The title sequence of Seven works as both a standalone vignette and as a vital introduction to the grimy and obsessive feel of the movie.
sentences.zh: 《七宗罪》的片名字幕既是一个独立的短片，又是对这部电影阴暗、偏执氛围至关重要的序幕。

sentences.en: The serial killer in Seven doesn't appear until two-thirds of the way into the film.
sentences.zh: 《七宗罪》中的连环杀手直到电影进行了三分之二才露面。

sentences.en: But you really get to know the killer right here in the first two minutes.
sentences.zh: 但你在头两分钟就能真正了解这个杀手。

sentences.en: Kyle Cooper took us inside his head.
sentences.zh: 凯尔·库珀带我们走进了他的内心世界。

sentences.en: The most memorable title sequences are really ones where, you know, there's a great movie after it.
sentences.zh: 最让人难忘的片名字幕，通常都是在它之后有一部伟大的电影作为支撑。

sentences.en: If Seven was put in front of some, you know, terrible movie that no one saw, it wouldn't have moved on to influence a generation of title designers after it.
sentences.zh: 如果把《七宗罪》的片头放在某部无人问津的烂片前面，它就不会去影响后来整整一代的片名字幕设计师了。

sentences.en: One of Ian Albinson's favorite title sequences is another Kyle Cooper creation, The Island of Dr. Moreau.
sentences.zh: 伊恩·阿尔宾森最喜欢的片名字幕之一是凯尔·库珀的另一部作品《人魔岛》。

sentences.en: It was the one that kicked Ian in the head and made him start noticing titles in the first place.
sentences.zh: 正是这部作品给了伊恩当头棒喝，让他开始注意到片名字幕的存在。

sentences.en: But if you were smart, you probably didn't see The Island of Dr. Moreau, and you don't know how cool the title sequence is.
sentences.zh: 但如果你足够聪明，你可能并没有看过《人魔岛》，也不知道它的片名字幕有多酷。

sentences.en: But every human on Earth over the age of 20 knows the name of Gareth Smith's favorite title sequence.
sentences.zh: 不过地球上所有 20 岁以上的人都知道加雷思·史密斯最喜欢的片名字幕叫什么。

sentences.en: The TV title sequence for Cheers, I can watch that endlessly.
sentences.zh: 电视剧《欢乐酒店》的片名字幕，我可以看个没完。

sentences.en: I remember liking it before I was a designer or had anything to do with design, so I was trying to put my finger on why I like it.
sentences.zh: 我记得在成为设计师或与设计扯上关系之前，我就很喜欢它，所以我一直在琢磨自己为什么喜欢它。

sentences.en: And, of course, a great theme song on that title sequence makes a big difference.
sentences.zh: 当然，片名字幕配上一首极佳的主题曲会带来很大的不同。

sentences.en: But it also just has lovely typography, very simple, lovely typography.
sentences.zh: 但它也拥有极美的排版，非常简洁、优美的排版。

sentences.en: And the editing of the sequence is fantastic.
sentences.zh: 而且该序列的剪辑堪称绝妙。

sentences.en: It just captures the entire tone of the television show in 30 seconds to a minute.
sentences.zh: 它只用了 30 秒到 1 分钟的时间，就捕捉到了整部电视剧的精髓。

sentences.en: Cheers is a montage of historical drawings and photographs of people enjoying themselves in bars.
sentences.zh: 《欢乐酒店》是一组历史画作和照片的蒙太奇，展现了人们在酒吧里尽情享受的场景。

sentences.en: And what they do underneath each of the title cards for the actors is they actually find a historical image that does sort of suggest that character in the television series.
sentences.zh: 他们在演员的每个名字卡片下方所做的，实际上是找到了一张能够暗示电视剧中该角色的历史图片。

sentences.en: The reason I enjoy it is warmth and friendship.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢它的原因是它充满了温暖与友谊。

sentences.en: And that really comes across, I think, in that title sequence.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种感觉在片名字幕中表现得淋漓尽致。

sentences.en: There are a lot of fans of film title design out there.
sentences.zh: 现在有很多电影片名字幕的粉丝。

sentences.en: I was trying to figure out why that is, and I feel like film title design more than other sorts of design has a bit of a longevity because it is committed to film.
sentences.zh: 我一直在试图弄清楚这是为什么，我觉得电影片名字幕比其他类型的设计更有长久生命力，因为它托迹于电影。

sentences.en: I guess, you know, a lot of design is commercial or prints, and it kind of is designed to exist for a week or two weeks and to just vanish from the face of the planet.
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道的，很多设计都是商业的或印刷品，它们的设计目的就是存在一两周，然后从地球上消失。

sentences.en: Whereas film design, you really do have to think about what is this going to look like in 25 years?
sentences.zh: 而电影设计，你确实必须考虑这在 25 年后会是什么样子？

sentences.en: You hope that the movie you're working on is going to be one of those movies that's going to be seen many years from now, you know, and it has to kind of hold up over time.
sentences.zh: 你希望你参与的电影能成为多年后依然会被人观看的电影之一，你知道的，它必须经得起时间的考验。

sentences.en: For videos and links to all the titles we talked about in this episode, as well as a kick-ass montage of kick-ass titles edited together by Ian Albinson, go to the website.
sentences.zh: 有关本期节目中我们讨论的所有片名字幕的视频和链接，以及由伊恩·阿尔宾森剪辑的精彩片名字幕混剪，请访问我们的网站。

sentences.en: It's 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 网址是 99percentinvisible.org。

sentences.en: Ooh, I want to do a little social media outreach before you go.
sentences.zh: 哦，在你离开之前，我想做一点社交媒体宣传。

sentences.en: If you could go like the show on Facebook, that would mean a great deal to me because there's this other project that's actually really noble called The 99 Percent,
sentences.zh: 如果你能在 Facebook 上给节目点个赞，对我都意义重大，因为还有另一个非常崇高的项目叫《百分之一》，

sentences.en: and I just want to get more fans than that.
sentences.zh: 我只是想获得比它更多的粉丝。

sentences.en: So there's like thousands and thousands and thousands of you, like on average, like 10,000, 12,000 of you who listen to this weekly.
sentences.zh: 所以你们有成千上万的人，平均每周有 10,000 到 12,000 人收听这个节目。

sentences.en: And I have almost 700 fans on Facebook, so I think we can do better.
sentences.zh: 而我在 Facebook 上将近有 700 个粉丝，所以我觉得我们能做得更好。

sentences.en: Okay, that's one.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这是第一个。

sentences.en: The other one is if you would take the time to review this show in iTunes, you would not believe the impact it has.
sentences.zh: 第二个是，如果你能花点时间在 iTunes 上给这个节目写个评价，你绝对不会相信它产生的影响。

sentences.en: You're like a Nielsen family, but you get to choose yourself when you review something on iTunes.
sentences.zh: 你们就像尼尔森收视家庭一样，但当你在 iTunes 上评论时，你是自己做选择的。

sentences.en: It represents millions of people.
sentences.zh: 它代表了数百万的人。

sentences.en: It's crazy.
sentences.zh: 这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: The rankings, like go up instantly when I get one review in iTunes.
sentences.zh: 当我收到一条 iTunes 评价时，排名瞬间就会飙升。

sentences.en: So if you could do that too, I hear five stars is a very popular option.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你也能顺便做这件事，我听说五星好评是一个非常受欢迎的选择。

sentences.en: That would mean so much.
sentences.zh: 那将意味着一切。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好了。

sentences.en: Thank you, 99th percentile.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们，前百分之一的精英听众。

sentences.en: We'll talk next week.
sentences.zh: 我们下周见。
